text.tspan: One point per task, in units of (score − random) / (1 − random). The grey line is no change.

tspan.tspan: Above it a task improved after the model moved on; below it the task was forgotten.

text.tspan: Ours contributes 150 points: 50 tasks × 3 complete seeds.
The other three have one complete seed each so far, so 50 points apiece; their remaining seeds are still running.
This is the backward-transfer column read one task at a time, and it is where ours and CKA-RL stop being close.
